thread.title: Special Participation A: GPT-5 HW4
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/g8roLrS4bYkQKvYuk0BiquHH" filename="EECS_182_HW_4_GPT_5_Trace.pdf"/><paragraph>Generally. GPT-5 generates accurate answers for conceptual and computation questions. There are some conventions that it chooses to use that we don't use in class, like Xavier initialization using 1/sqrt(d). Some questions also required some further prompting, though generally one-shot is quite accurate.</paragraph></document>
